name: Garran
aliases: the old man on the truckle bed
status: alive, gravely ill, unchanged at dawn

physicalDetails.detail: Old; lies on a child's truckle bed with his feet hanging off the end in grey stockings; face the colour of a tallow candle, skin stretched across the bones of the nose; breath catches wet at the top; belly under the sheepskin round and hard; the sweetness has gone off his breath, replaced by 'meat kept too long'. At dawn skin dry and hot as a stove; the brown still out along his arms and up his neck, no further than at night. No teeth to speak of (Tobin pulled the last at Midsummer). Bleeding cut at the inside of the elbow from Tobin's bleeding, dressed with a pad and a strip that keeps slipping.

bodyLanguagePatterns.detail: Takes sops as a baby does, lips working, swallowing; does not open his eyes.

knowledge.detail: Lives alone in a cottage on Cooper's Lane three doors from the cooper (wife gone since the spring); first in the village and worst in the room; ate sops (bread soaked in milk) twice a day for about three months, from loaves Ellen sent up; the contamination is in every system, every thread running back to the gut. Tobin brought him to the chapel.

arc.currentPosition: Survives the night on Jaina's wards and Mother Haw's oatcakes; stable, not improving.
